findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Specify that the rewritten transition_ticket tool docstring must co-locate the reason decision rule: which close_class values are reason-required (obsolete/wontfix/not_a_bug/escalated) and that reason persists as close_reason only on a non-force close of those classes (else it is the force audit comment).
evidence: src/rebar/_lib_writes.py:286-288 — admits_close_reason = not (force or force_close) and (close_class in REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES)
Ticket comment (deep-dive G3): 'MCP uses pydantic + LLM-facing docstrings (the description IS the contract the model reads)'
Ticket experiment comment: 'An agent on MCP is told to provide something the surface can't express -> a compliant reason-required bug close is UNREACHABLE'
Plan prose specifies rewriting force/audit prose but is silent on documenting the reason-required class vocabulary or the non-force+class conditional
findings.finding: The plan requires exposing a new `reason` parameter on transition_ticket and rewriting the LLM-facing tool prose to the absent-attestation audit model, but does not require that prose to co-locate the decision rule governing WHEN reason is required/persisted. Per _lib_writes.py, `reason` persists as close_reason ONLY on a non-force close whose close_class is in REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES {obsolete, wontfix, not_a_bug, escalated}; otherwise it is the force audit comment. Without this rule stated in the tool docstring the model reads, an agent cannot know when a reason-required close needs reason — the very 'A->C trap' the ticket's experiment (comment 3) identified.
findings.location: Repair plan bullet 'Replace the rescinded no-force tool prose...' and AC line 'MCP tool prose describes absent certification as the audit signal'
scenarios: An MCP agent attempts a reason-required close (e.g. not_a_bug/wontfix) and omits reason because the docstring never says reason is required for those classes
An agent supplies reason on a force close or a non-reason-required class and is surprised it is silently discarded
findings.suggested_fix: Add to the Repair plan / AC that the transition_ticket docstring must name the reason-required close_class vocabulary and state that `reason` is persisted as close_reason only on a non-force close whose class is in that set, and otherwise serves as the force audit comment.
